listener.policy.body: An alert goes to the system status channel after 15 minutes without a connection. The recovery message comes after 15 minutes of stable connection.

secrets.title: Credentials
secrets.help: The app never shows these values.
gpage.title: Google access
gpage.start.help: Use the family calendar account. The steps take approximately 1 minute.
gpage.step1: Select "Open Google". Google opens in a new tab.
gpage.step2: Sign in with the family calendar account.
gpage.step3: If Google shows a warning, select "Continue". Select the calendar box. Then select "Continue".
gpage.step4: Safari shows "Cannot connect". This is the correct result.
gpage.step5: Copy the full address from the address bar. Paste the address in this field.
gpage.saved: Google access is saved. It expires on {date}.
gpage.saved.jobs: The 07:00 recap and the 10:00 job use the new access at their next run.
gpage.saved.probe_ok: The test with the new access is OK.
gpage.saved.probe_fail: The new access is saved, but the test failed. Do the steps in docs/maintenance.md.
gpage.restart: Restart the listener to use the new access in Slack.
gpage.restart.member: Ask the administrator to restart the listener. Then Slack replies use the new access.
google.err.state: This address is from a different sign-in. Start again from step 1.
google.err.expired: This sign-in is older than 10 minutes. Start again from step 1.
google.err.denied: Google did not give access. Make sure that you use the family calendar account.
google.err.no_code: This address has no Google code. Copy the full address again.
google.err.bad_address: This text is not the address from Safari. Copy the full address again.
google.err.no_attempt: No sign-in is open. Start again from step 1.
google.err.exchange: Google did not accept this address. Start again from step 1.
google.err.no_refresh: Google did not give long-term access. Start again from step 1.
google.err.scope: Calendar access was not selected. Start again and select the calendar box.
google.err.network: The Mini cannot connect to Google now. Do the action again after 1 minute.
google.err.config: The Google client ID or secret is not set. Do the steps in docs/maintenance.md.
google.err.write: The access was not saved. The .env file did not change. Do the steps in docs/maintenance.md.
restart.title: Restart the listener?
restart.body: Replies stop for approximately 30 seconds. Messages from this time can receive a late reply.
restart.done: The listener started again at {time}. New process: {pid}.
restart.waiting: The restart started at {time}. The app waits for the new process. This page updates every 5 seconds.
restart.timeout: No new listener process after 2 minutes. Do the steps in docs/maintenance.md.
restart.limit: You can restart the listener again after {time}.
restart.failed: The restart did not start. launchctl gave error {code}. Do the steps in docs/maintenance.md.
restart.unavailable: Restart is not available on this computer. launchd runs only on macOS.
restart.prompt: Restart the listener to use the new setting.
